theorems.name: Submission.gaussGreenRep_measure_eq_iSup_pairing
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (O : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N), IsOpen O → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ν μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖ν x‖ = 1) → μ O = ⨆ (g : Rn N → Rn N) (_ : Continuous g) (_ : HasCompactSupport g) (_ : tsupport g ⊆ O) (_ : ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1), ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, inner ℝ (g x) (ν x) ∂μ)
